items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And he became Peter's manager for his theatrical career.

ctx.x: And he's now a successful studio player in Southern California. And he became Peter's manager for his theatrical career.
And during one period when they were both -- before they were in my band, they were Tommy Dorsey, and they got Tommy steamed up to get a screen test at MGM for Pete.
